column1: # Tolbi in the rain: the festival goes on while the city strains.

column3:
Turn your back on the
Spring and toss a coin.{page_break}People say it grants
wishes. Lately folks wish
for the rain to stop.{end_wait}

A Lucky Medal is worth
more than a coin.{page_break}Mine bought me one night
of sleep. Nobody sleeps
well now.{end_wait}
Ah. Luck left with the sun.\nAnd you?{end_wait}
I keep losing coins, but I\ncan't stop. Everyone's\nlosing something lately.{end_wait}

The festival goes on. Babi
says stopping it would
start a panic.{page_break}There's a panic anyway.
It's just quiet.{end_wait}

Colosso's in the colosseum,
where it's driest. Get
there early.{page_break}People are shoving for
seats like it's the last
dry place on earth.{end_wait}
Tryouts started today. I'll\nwatch the finals, if the\nroof holds.{page_break}And if the town does.{end_wait}

Colosso is underway.
Why are Babi's guards
searching the streets?{page_break}They carry their swords
as if expecting trouble.
If Babi is in danger,{page_break}nobody will say so.{end_wait}

Babi was old when I was
born, and I'm 65 now.{page_break}A man can't live that
long. Something's wrong
in this town.{end_wait}
Can anyone live past a\nhundred years?{end_now}
Hmm. Babi is a lot older\nthan that. It worries me\nmore than the rain does.{end_wait}
Perhaps. Then what about\nBabi? He's got fifty years\non me, easily.{end_wait}

Whee! The festival! It
doesn't stop for the rain!{page_break}What'll I buy with Mama's
money? Not bread. Bread's
gone.{end_wait}
Waah! She said that money\nwas for both of us!{end_wait}
Souvenirs! Remember Tolbi\nbefore the harbor patrols\ncame!{end_wait}
Snacks and drinks, double!\nBabi's soldiers took half\nmy stock for the harbor.{end_wait}

I decided not to fight in
Colosso after all.{page_break}The contestants are huge.
A few have grey in their
eyes. Not for me.{end_wait}
Tolbi's festival is huge!\nIgnore the rain and the\nrumors, and it's lovely.{end_wait}

We came a day too late and
now the colosseum's full.{page_break}Nowhere to go but the
street, and the street is
a river.{end_wait}
Children love\nsouvenirs, don't they?{end_now}

You like them too. Don't
hide it! I used to buy
them all.{page_break}Now the wife says we
can't afford it.{end_wait}
Hmph! You say that because\nyour parents never bought\nyou any!{end_wait}
Be patient, little one.{end_wait}
I'll buy you\nsomething better later.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Waah!{reset_text_style} I'm hungry!\nBuy me sweets! Please\nbuy me sweets!{end_wait}

Every inn is full, so I
sleep here.{page_break}This archway keeps the
rain off. It's almost a
bed.{end_wait}
Tourists aren't the only\nones who love Colosso.\nWe need it.{end_wait}
The trials start at the\ncolosseum today.{page_break}Win and you eat well\nuntil the finals.{end_wait}
The trials are fine. It's\nthe finals everyone needs\nto get through this.{end_wait}
No trouble, they say. Then\nwhy are soldiers hauling\ncarts to the pier at night?{end_wait}
Every year I get older and\nBabi stays the same. It\nisn't natural.{end_wait}
What if Babi is a\ndifferent man now?{page_break}What if no one's dared\nto tell us?{end_wait}
I'm the oldest, so I\nshould keep the\nallowance.{end_wait}
Mama told us to share.\nDoes my brother not\nremember?{end_wait}
We have to sell these\nsouvenirs before the\nrain washes us out.{end_wait}
They sell these at the\ncolosseum too, but\nhere they're dry!{end_wait}
I saw the fighters. A few\nhad grey in their eyes.\nThey didn't talk.{end_wait}
Tolbi isn't like Xian.\nHere even the rain is loud.{end_wait}

I shouldn't say this, but
I got afraid to watch
Colosso.{page_break}So I overslept on
purpose.{end_wait}

The stalls along the
street smell wonderful.{page_break}If my children
buy some, I'll get
a bite too.{end_wait}
Why do children want\nsuch terrible food?{page_break}I'm not buying that!\nNo matter what!{end_wait}
Those sweets smell great.\nI am not moving until\nyou buy me some.{end_wait}

I've guarded our spot, but
it's hardly worth it.{page_break}I hope my friends get
here before the water
does.{end_wait}
Hey, have you seen\nanyone who looks like\nthis?{end_now}
Babi must be nearby!!!{end_wait}
Where is Babi? He\nis not here. Let's\nlook over there.{end_wait}

Colosso reaches its
peak any minute now.{page_break}Hurry to the colosseum
before the crowd turns
ugly!{end_wait}
Are you watching the\nfinals? They may have\nstarted already!{end_wait}
My family saved me a seat.\nStill, we should go. They\nlock the harbor after dark.{end_wait}

I thought something had
happened to Babi.{page_break}He showed up at the
finals, so it was
nothing. Probably.{end_wait}
The colosseum was too full\nto get in. All I did was\nthe Lucky Guess.{end_wait}
Nobody has said it, but\nthis festival is a way to\nnot look at the harbor.{end_wait}
It's the finals!\nSeven warriors remain!\nOnly one will live!{end_wait}
Waah! My brother spent all\nour money on the Lucky\nGuess!{end_wait}
Colosso souvenirs!\nLast chance! Thirty\npercent off!{end_wait}
The finals are long. Buy\nfood now, before it runs\nout!{end_wait}
The trials were\ngripping.{page_break}The finals will be\nbetter. I can't wait.{end_wait}
I have seats to the\nfinals. They cost far\ntoo much.{end_wait}
I overslept again, and the\ncolosseum is full!{page_break}Maybe I should buy a\nseat from a scalper...{end_wait}
There are always scalpers\nat the finals.{page_break}They only cheat people\nfrom the countryside.{end_wait}
The finals are about to\nstart. It's kind of sad.{end_wait}
Wait until Colosso\nends, like a good\nchild.{end_wait}
Prices drop when Colosso\nends, so buying now\nis foolish!{end_wait}
They said they would\nbuy it after Colosso.\nI doubt it.{end_wait}
The finals start today. I\nhope my buddy is all right.{page_break}If you need a seat,\nbuy a ticket from him.{end_wait}
I have to get to the\ncolosseum.{page_break}What if I miss the best\npart of the battle?{end_wait}
A battle to the death\nwith 7 strong warriors.\nHow exciting!{end_wait}
The finals start on\nBabi's signal.\nI love that part!{end_wait}
If nothing's wrong with\nBabi, why were the soldiers\nso upset?{end_wait}
I could still buy a\nseat from a scalper,\nbut I hate that.{end_wait}
However I add it up, this\nfestival keeps going. Babi\nwon't let it stop.{end_wait}
We could win big if we\nspent our rent on the\nLucky Guess.{end_wait}
Mama, why did you\nlisten to my brother?{end_wait}
We can't sell anything\nonce the finals end.\nSell it now!{end_wait}
The final push!\nWhatever doesn't sell\nwill rot in the rain!{end_wait}
Fighting in Colosso\ntakes real power.\nI could never do it.{end_wait}
They sell finals seats at\nthe entrance. It's robbery!{end_wait}
It's supposed to be\nfree. Buying seats from\nscalpers is a shame.{end_wait}
When Colosso ends, our\nlives can go back to\nnormal. If they can.{end_wait}
Festivals are so\nexpensive. My purse is\nempty!{end_wait}
Mom, you said you were\nout of money, but\nyou aren't!{end_wait}
Today is a big day for\nus scalpers. Right,\nbuddy?{end_wait}
This year's Colosso has\nended.{page_break}Come back next year, if\nTolbi is still here.{end_wait}
Back to quiet lives now\nthat Colosso is over?{page_break}Quiet, and wet, and\nafraid of the water.{end_wait}
You were in the finals,\nweren't you?{end_now}
I was moved by how\ndetermined you were, for\nsuch a small fighter.{end_wait}
You weren't? You look\njust like that warrior.{end_wait}

With the revelers gone,
the town feels empty.{page_break}The days after the
festival are lonely.
Rainier, too.{end_wait}
I had no luck at the Lucky\nGuess. Maybe the rain will\nease next year.{end_wait}
It's so quiet! The\nnoise of Colosso\nfeels like a dream!{end_wait}
Yay! It's easy to run\nwith no one around.\nExcept for the puddles.{end_wait}
Ha ha! This is fun! My\nbig brother is being\nnice to me again!{end_wait}
I'll be back to do\nbusiness next year, if\nthere's a next year.{end_wait}
These are leftovers,\nbut have some. Nobody\nelse wants them!{end_wait}
The festival ran longer\nthis year, so I made more.{page_break}I'd rather have had\nthe sun.{end_wait}
The spectators have gone,\nso we have to clean up.\nWhat a mess!{end_wait}
Imagine having Colosso\nall year long!{page_break}Whew. That would be\na lot of work for us.{end_wait}

Warriors who win fame in
the finals become Babi's
soldiers.{page_break}That's why his soldiers
are so strong.{end_wait}

No ships are sailing the
Karagol. The soldiers say
the water isn't safe.{page_break}Not the water, I think.
What's in it.{end_wait}

Since Colosso ended so
dramatically, the Lucky
Guess goes to...{page_break}Dang. A little more luck
and I'd be rich.{end_wait}
The calm after the storm is\nnice too. Only this storm\nstays.{end_wait}
Tolbi's main street\nis so wide open!{end_wait}
My brother was mean to\nme during the festival.\nHe changed completely!{end_wait}
Every year I try to sell\neverything and fail.{page_break}How do I carry all this\nhome in the rain?{end_wait}
How can we get home if\nsea monsters block the\ncrossing?{end_wait}
